scholarships.name: Future Network Weimar Triangle: Science for Europe - Postdoctoral researchers (to Germany) **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The programme **“Future Network Weimar Triangle: Science for Europe”** aims to expand the political initiative “Weimar Triangle”, launched in 1991 by the foreign ministers of Germany, France, and Poland, to include a sustainable science platform (to promote trilateral cooperation between Germany, France, and Poland). The programme aims to develop innovative solutions to European and global challenges through joint research projects and to strengthen European integration and the European Research Area through networking and exchange.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadline: November 2, 2026 Selection period: January 2027 Funding begins: April - September 2027
scholarships.sourceQuote: Exceptionally qualified researchers in all disciplines who wish to apply for a research stay up to 24 months in Germany and would like to get involved in one of the future-oriented topics listed below and are open to taking on the role of technical coordinator for one of the five working groups within the scholarship programme: **Technologies for climate-neutral energy production and mobility, as…
